narrative_engine.thesis: trend down context (H4 stack down · D1 stack down · EMA spread -10.30 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP) set the SHORT bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 0.05825-0.05833 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip), where the footprint printed its confirmation. Risk is defined beyond 0.06074; the first objective pays 0.91R at 0.05773.

plan.triggerRule: footprint div fired sell in short direction at the zone
plan.invalidation: structure beyond 0.06074 (signal zone / ±2σ VWAP / 0.5 ATR buffer)
vetoes: M1 R 0.91 < 1.5 — reward does not pay the risk

athena_oracle.verdict: Cautious bearish lean 31/100 — trend broken, whales offering
